title: Only a boy named David
lyrics_original: Only a boy named David, only a little sling,
only a boy named David, but he could pray and sing.
Only a boy named David, only a rippling brook,
only a boy named David, but five little stones he took.
And one little stone went in the sling,
and the sling went round and round.
And one little stone went in the sling,
and the sling went round and round,
and round and round and round and round,
and round and round and round.
And one little stone went up in the air,
and the giant came tumbling down.

bible_verses.telugu: తన కఱ్ఱ చేత పట్టుకొని యేటి లోయలో నుండి అయిదు నున్నని రాళ్లను ఏరుకొని తనయొద్దనున్న చిక్కములో నుంచుకొని వడిసెల చేత పట్టుకొని ఆ ఫిలిష్తీ యుని చేరువకు పోయెను.
bible_verses.english: Then he took his staff in his hand, chose five smooth stones from the stream, put them in the pouch of his shepherd’s bag and, with his sling in his hand, approached the Philistine.

bible_verses.telugu: తన సంచిలో చెయ్యివేసి అందులోనుండి రాయి యొకటి తీసి వడిసెలతో విసరి ఆ ఫిలిష్తీయునినుదుట కొట్టెను. ఆ రాయి వాని నుదురుచొచ్చినందున వాడు నేలను బోర్లపడెను.
bible_verses.english: Reaching into his bag and taking out a stone, he slung it and struck the Philistine on the forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell facedown on the ground.
But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for reminding me that You do not require grand human strength to work miracles. I bring You my small offerings today—my simple gifts, my humble prayers, and my quiet praise. When the challenges before me feel giant and overwhelming, help me to fix my eyes on Your greatness instead of my limitations. Use my life to show Your power and grace to the world around me. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for reminding me that You do not require grand human strength to work miracles. devotional.reflection_english: It is easy to feel small or under-equipped when facing the giants of life. Yet this beloved song reminds us that God delights in using humble, simple things to display His mighty power. Young David brought only a sling, five smooth stones, and a heart full of prayer and praise to the battlefield. Today, as you surrender your small gifts and ordinary moments to the Lord, trust that He can use them to bring about extraordinary victories in His name.
